title: Pixar's Hoppers trounces The Bride at the weekend box office
desc: Pixar's 'Hoppers' was the weekend's big winner at the box office with a remarkable $46 million first take, while Maggie Gyllenhaal's 'The Bride' barely showed signs of life with $7.2 million.

title: Ireland prevail after shootout to reach Hockey World Cup
desc: The Ireland women's team will compete at this year's FIH Hockey World Cup after defeating Japan 3-1 in a penalty shootout in Chile.
